arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random
rng=random.Random(21)
cases=[]
for c in range(8):
    S=256; J=128; F=32; G=32
    times=[s*(1000+c) for s in range(S)]
    groups=[]
    for g in range(G):
        parent=-1 if g<3 else rng.choice([-1,g-1,rng.randint(0,g-1)])
        groups.append([parent,rng.choice([3,5,9,512])])
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        flows.append([4, rng.choice([4,6,512]), rng.randint(0,G-1), rng.randint(0,6)])
    windows=[]
    for j in range(J):
        f=j%F
        windows.append([f,0,times[-1],1,1,0,rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    cases.append({'model':'cnn' if c%2 else 'rnn','class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
      'stats':[100,100000,1000000],
      'bucket':[rng.choice([2,5,512]),rng.choice([0,2,512])],
      'slots':[[times[s],rng.choice([1,2,512]),0 if s==0 else rng.choice([0,1,2])] for s in range(S)],
      'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows})
json.dump({'version':3,'cases':cases},open('/workspace/tmp/batch8b.json','w'))
print('ok')
PYEOF
cd /workspace && time (python3 public_exec.py /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/batch8b.json > /workspace/tmp/batch8b.out 2>/workspace/tmp/batch8b.err; echo exit=$?); ls -la /workspace/tmp/batch8b.out; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/batch8b.out'))
for i,r in enumerate(d['results']): print(i,r['ratio'],'cut',r['cut'] and len(r['cut']),'U',r['utility'],'A',r['age'],'assigned',sum(1 for x in r['assignment'] if x>=0),'flowlen',len(r['flow']))
"; head -c 200 /workspace/tmp/batch8b.err
